title: Great app, and free!
body:
Simple and effective habit tracker, love the simple 1 tap input, and the colorful bubbles that grow as your habits get stronger. A really great job for a first version 👍

One of the few apps on this market that’s still free and doesn’t offer a paid subscription to access full functionality or remove ads 🙌

A couple of caveats:

- The main screen gets fairly cluttered when you have many habits to track, you end up having to scroll up and down a lot. Maybe a compact list view as an option could help, or the possibility to group habits by theme (e.g. health, relationships, work).

- It isn’t clear whether or not weekly habits (or any non daily repetition) get tracked properly in terms of percentage. I haven’t gone through a full month yet, so I can’t confirm. But at the very least the interface doesn’t make that clear at all.

- Negative habits (e.g. no coffee, less alcohol) are a bit awkward to track. A dedicated feature would probably help. You may want to look at what other habit trackers are doing on that front 😉

All that being said, it’s pretty great app overall, I’ll definitely keep tracking my habits and growing them this way. Thanks for that 🙏
